split_protocol.memory: KC1 saved coefficients restricted to other four folds; standardization fitted only on allowed fold memory
split_protocol.query_training: EH rows from other four folds only; fold-heldout episodes excluded from optimizer and memory
split_protocol.evaluation_rows: EH rows assigned to each heldout fold; locked Dev-v2 and unseen20 with KC1 full production query

confidence_orientation: positive score means uncertainty/higher predicted error; margins and top5 mass are sign-reversed for this interpretation
selection_rule: maximum crossfit pooled Spearman of oriented uncertainty against e_arm; Dev-v2 is reported as transfer check, unseen20 is report-only
expert_style_reference_rule: Recreate KQ2-CL Expert's rank-law draft sampler for comparison only.
